name: acceleration_momentum_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, large directional institutional orders (FII flow, ETF rebalancing, index arb) are executed incrementally via TWAP/VWAP algos, causing the 1-minute ROC to ramp up progressively before the full move is obvious. When the 30-second change in 1-minute momentum (ROC_accel) turns positive for 15+ consecutive seconds and its own slope is rising, NIFTY is in the 'jerk phase' — the third derivative is positive, meaning algorithmic participation is actively growing. At 5-second resolution we can enter during this early acceleration window, capturing the first 6-12 option points before reactive momentum traders pile in and the acceleration peaks.

indicators.name: roc_12
indicators.purpose: 12 bars = 60 seconds of momentum. Original used ROC(10) on 1-min = 10-min context; for a 30-90s hold we need 1-min momentum, not 10-min. Holding 30-90s and measuring 10-min momentum would make the signal too lagged — by the time 10-min ROC turns positive the move is already half over.

indicators.name: roc_accel
indicators.purpose: 6 bars = 30 seconds — the 30-second change in 1-minute momentum. Positive means momentum is actively building (not just sustained). Original used 5-bar (5-min) change in 10-min ROC; compressed to maintain the same ratio of accel_window / hold_time (30s window / 90s hold ≈ 5min / 20min original).

indicators.name: roc_accel_slope
indicators.purpose: 3 bars = 15-second trend of acceleration. Confirms the acceleration is rising (not just a single-bar spike). Minimal 3-bar window to detect direction of the second derivative without over-smoothing.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.purpose: Session-cumulative VWAP as trend direction filter — ensures we trade accelerating momentum aligned with the intraday dominant trend, not against it.

indicators.name: vol_sma20
indicators.purpose: 100-second volume context. Above-average volume during acceleration confirms institutional participation, not retail noise.

conditions: roc_accel > accel_threshold for 3+ consecutive bars (15s of confirmed acceleration)
buy_ce.confirmation: 3 consecutive bars with roc_accel > threshold (15 seconds of sustained acceleration)

conditions: roc_accel < -accel_threshold for 3+ consecutive bars (15s of confirmed deceleration/acceleration down)
buy_pe.confirmation: 3 consecutive bars with roc_accel < -threshold (15 seconds of sustained downside acceleration)

exit.stop_rationale: 3 option points = ~6 NIFTY spot points. A momentum acceleration signal that immediately reverses 6 spot points within seconds means the acceleration was noise; at delta ~0.5 that is 3 option pts. If the jerk-phase thesis is correct, drawdowns should not exceed 4-6 spot pts before the continuation begins.
exit.target_rationale: 6 option points = ~12 NIFTY spot points. NIFTY 30-90 second momentum bursts following confirmed acceleration typically cover 15-25 spot points; targeting 6 option pts captures ~50% of the expected continuation leg with a 1:2 R:R.

filters.vix_filter: none — momentum acceleration is valid across VIX regimes; high VIX actually amplifies moves
filters.time_filter: no entries before 09:25 (first 10 min is pre-open noise) or after 15:20
filters.trend_filter: close vs VWAP — trade only with intraday trend direction
filters.spread_filter: not needed — limit orders, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — second-derivative signals are noisier at 5s than at 1-min; the 3-bar confirmation and slope filter are critical noise gatekeepers

adaptation_notes: Original strategy ran on NIFTY200 equity stocks at 1-min bars with 10-30 min holds. Key changes: (1) ROC_10 on 1-min → ROC_12 on 5s (same 1-minute window, same time, more bars); however lookback compressed from 10-min ROC to 1-min ROC because our hold is 30-90s not 10-30 min. (2) ROC_accel window: 5 bars (5-min) → 6 bars (30s), maintaining ~1/3 ratio of accel_window to hold_time. (3) Removed ATR stop (not applicable to option premiums), replaced with fixed option-point stop calibrated to typical NIFTY 30-90s move. (4) Volume filter kept but now applies to index volume as institutional participation proxy. (5) VWAP filter kept unchanged — session-cumulative VWAP has no lookback scaling issue.
weaknesses: Second derivative amplifies noise quadratically — the 3-bar confirmation and slope filter are essential but may still produce false signals on choppy NIFTY sessions
Confirmation delay: 3 bars = 15 seconds of confirmed acceleration may enter too late on very fast momentum bursts (which complete in 20-30 seconds)
NIFTY volume is noisy at 5s frequency — vol_sma20 filter may not reliably distinguish institutional from retail flow at this timescale
Strategy may under-trade on low-volatility range days where momentum never accelerates enough to meet all conditions

_source.original_stop: 0.25% from entry with trailing stop at 0.15%
_source.original_target: exit when ROC_accel turns negative (peak momentum)
